note:
Paper 76, Team 36178, a 2015 paper on locating and then searching for an aircraft lost over water. Eleven measured regions over nine of the twenty pages: ten figure rows and one refusal, nothing unaccounted for and nothing unresolved. The paper prints seven numbered figures and all seven are here; the other three rows are the unnumbered pictures of the closing press release. It prints no tables at all, and the word Table never occurs in its text layer.

What the exhibits are. Four drawings carry the geometry: Figure 1's three hand-drawn search patterns, Figure 3's flight legs against the turn distance, Figure 6's labelled leg of a search path, and the letter's two-panel picture of the parallel and diagonal patterns. Three scatters carry the end-location sets of Figures 4 and 5 and the algorithm comparison of Figure 7, which is the paper's only plotted result and the only exhibit with a data series in it. Two maps carry the ocean current field - Figure 2 in the body and the same field again on the letter's last page - and one line plot on p19 redraws the end-location geometry for the letter.

The refusal is the summary sheet's cover form, which spans the full text measure at the top of page 1 and measures larger than any real exhibit in the paper. It is a registration block: team number, problem chosen, and the blank lines the contest leaves for its own entries.

What is unusual here is the text layer. The letter on pp19-20 is set in a face whose subset has no space glyph, so every space in its three captions reaches the layer as a dollar sign, and its coordinate annotation reaches the layer as replacement characters. Nothing in that spread can be quoted, so all three captions are typed from the crops. The letter also repeats the paper's own results without cross-referencing them: its end-location picture is Figures 4 and 5 drawn again, and its current-field picture is Figure 2 drawn again, neither carrying a number or a reference back.

Two smaller defects are worth recording. Figure 2's caption has no full stop - the verbatim stops on its reference bracket because that is where the printed caption stops - and Figure 6's caption closes on a spaced-out parenthesis, so its verbatim keeps the gap. The heading index is a third: it reads the five aircraft of p6 as headings numbered 1 to 5 and both modelling subsections as heading 1, so every section path in this record was taken from the printed labels by hand rather than from the ctx chain.

Citation is thin and mostly deictic, except for Figure 1, which the prose on p5 names three times in one page. Figures 4 and 5 are announced a page before they print and Figure 7 a page before it prints, which is the only forward-lead behaviour in the paper.
rules: Families split four ways and the count is small enough to state: four flowchart-or-schematic drawings, three scatters, two map-or-plan-view frames and one line plot, ten rows in all. Only one exhibit in the paper - Figure 7 - is a plotted result; the rest are the geometry the model is argued with [geometry.family].

Two rows hold more than one panel and neither is a composite: Figure 1 is three hand-drawn patterns in a row and the press release's search-pattern picture is two boxed drawings in a row, and in both cases the panels are the same family, so each is one row with its panel count and its layout recorded [geometry.panel_count].

The two map-or-plan-view rows are the only exhibits whose frame is geographic rather than cartesian: Figure 2 and the press release's current-field picture both show satellite sea surface with the current field drawn over it and a coordinate string in the corner. The probability plots of Figures 4, 5 and 7 are cartesian scatter frames in arbitrary units and are recorded as scatter, not as maps [geometry.family].
Every caption in the paper prints BELOW its artwork, the seven numbered ones and the three italic letter captions alike, and nothing in the paper prints above [caption.position].

Numbering is 'Figure N:' for the seven printed figures, including Figure 2 whose caption carries no full stop at all and stops on its reference bracket. The three pictures on pp19-20 print no figure number anywhere - they are the press release's own pictures - so they are recorded with numbering 'none' and their captions typed from the crop [caption.numbering].

The letter's captions are unquotable from the text layer: page 19 prints 'The$full$range$of$end$locations$that$the$plane$could$have$crashed$at$' and page 20 prints 'The$different$search$patterns$' and 'A$vector$field$showing$how$ocean$currents$move$debris1$', every space rendered as a dollar sign because the letter's face has no space glyph in the subset. That is why all three are typed from the crop [caption.verbatim].

Citation is uneven: Figure 1 is named three times on p5, Figures 3, 4 and 5 are each named once on p8 although the art of 4 and 5 prints on p9, Figure 6 is named once inside a parenthesis on p11, and Figure 7 is named once on p13 for art on p14. Figure 2 is never named in prose at all [mention.count].

Three exhibits lead their section by a page and one trails: Figures 4 and 5 are cited on p8 and print on p9, Figure 7 is cited on p13 and prints on p14, while Figure 6 is cited and printed on the same page. Two of the paper's own sentences point at a figure that is not on the page they print on [mention.lead_pages].

Section paths are taken by hand from the printed headings because the index is unreliable on this paper: it returns 'Modeling a generic downed plane using parameters' and 'Modeling a generic search plane using parameters' as headings numbered 1, and the five aircraft of p6 as headings numbered 1 to 5, and it never returns a label for subsection 4.1.3's parent chain in the right order. Each path here is the chain of printed labels with matching numbers and pages [place.section_path].

The closing spread has no numbered heading at all - pages 19 and 20 print an italic two-line title, 'Addressing the Press Regarding the Plan for Future Searches', and no number - so the three rows there carry section_numbered false and the title behind the 未编号标题 prefix [place.section_path].

Area does not separate exhibits from furniture here either. The refusal on p1 is 0.236 of the page, larger than any figure in the paper, because the cover form spans the full text measure at the top of the sheet; the ten figure rows run from 0.072 to 0.184 [place.area_frac].

Nothing in this paper is a printed table. The word Table never once appears in the text layer across all twenty pages, so the table list is empty and the family distribution carries no table-grid [geometry.family].
